publication_boundary.raw_data_commit: Commit only official open-data fixtures with attribution; contract feeds and bulk archives stay out of the repository.
publication_boundary.github_pages: Publish evidence metadata, citations, fixtures, and expressly reusable summaries only; licensed prices, holdings, and index values stay off Pages.
publication_boundary.secrets: Credentials belong only in GitHub Actions repository/environment secret stores, never repository files or browser assets.
